scenarios.title: An unleashed creature enters with an additional +1/+1 counter
decisions: A casts Rakdos Cackler, tapping Mountain; it resolves.
As it enters, A chooses to have it enter with a +1/+1 counter.

variants.label: unleashed
variants.expected: Rakdos Cackler enters with one +1/+1 counter and is 2/2.

variants.label: not_unleashed
variants.delta: A chooses not to have Rakdos Cackler enter with a +1/+1 counter.
variants.expected: Rakdos Cackler enters with no counters and is 1/1.

scenarios.title: A creature with unleash can't block while it has a +1/+1 counter

setup.notes: Grizzly Bears is attacking player A. A is the defending player and is declaring blockers.

decisions: A tries to declare Rakdos Cackler as a blocker of Grizzly Bears.

variants.label: counter_on_cackler
variants.expected: The block is illegal: Rakdos Cackler has a +1/+1 counter, so it can't block.

variants.label: no_counter
variants.delta: Rakdos Cackler has no +1/+1 counter (it is 1/1).
variants.expected: The block is legal; Rakdos Cackler can block Grizzly Bears.

variants.label: counter_on_other_creature
variants.delta: A's creature is Runeclaw Bear with one +1/+1 counter instead of Rakdos Cackler.
variants.expected: The block is legal: Runeclaw Bear has no unleash, so its +1/+1 counter does not stop it blocking.
